LanguageData.LiAIChat_Sporecaster.label: Sporecaster
LanguageData.LiAIChat_Sporecaster.description: A mid-range bio-contamination rifle. Its spores accumulate in living targets and can spread as a toxic cloud when a heavily infected target dies. Firing causes mild spore exposure to the user.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_CorrosionProjector.label: Corrosion Projector
LanguageData.LiAIChat_CorrosionProjector.description: A mid-range anti-armor weapon. Its corrosive bolts temporarily reduce effective armor by up to 24%. Each shot damages the user's natural arms; artificial arms are unaffected.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_SporecasterBullet.label: sporecaster round
LanguageData.LiAIChat_CorrosionProjectorBolt.label: corrosive bolt
